title: AVSEGROUP officer appears at NBI, denies involvement in Laos drug incident
summary: Police Executive Master Sergeant (PEMS) Aileen Jayne Manalo Mendoza of the Philippine National Police (PNP) Aviation Security Group (AVSEGROUP) returned to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI)…

blocks.text: Police Executive Master Sergeant (PEMS) Aileen Jayne Manalo Mendoza of the Philippine National Police (PNP) Aviation Security Group (AVSEGROUP) returned to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Friday, maintaining that she had no involvement in the Laos drug incident.
